compiled_transform.interpretation: The final F20 scalar fallback retains four Y products, four X FMAs, translation adds, Z FMAs, then X-aspect multiplication. Register/dataflow checked against the original F19 disassembly used by the independent target oracle.

reviewed_invariants: Only immutable ELF topology and vertex source bytes are admitted; task owns the current dest0 slots and original bounded TRI words.

Dead-canonical suffix allows only bounded VTX overwrites and TRI reads disjoint from still-pending slots; all state/list/end/unknown operations reject. Deferred fog bits for proven dead slots are removed.

Existing survivor-materialize/drop runs before async admission. Accepted jobs release the legacy lease only after all previous alias dependencies have been consumed/dropped; ordinary forwarding remains allowed while a legacy lease is held.
Cached MTF2 material eligibility excludes LOD and vertex alpha except the existing ignored-fog shade-alpha=255 case. Captured UV/RGB/alpha/projection do not consult later renderer state.
Source-pool recycling drains async completed sequence before reusing source bytes; legacy idle lease does not itself count as an unfinished async job.

Repair reads frozen context/raw under the worker head, checks epoch/token before ACK and every output word, uses only the dedicated MMIO sink, and sends END only after every word and matching token/epoch.
Consumer reset preserves already granted legacy raw context/ticket and active LOAD, while async repair epoch advances. Pending acquires retry on epoch change; an unexpectedly lost held lease faults.
Final frame materializes remaining legacy lazy rows before releasing the lease. Full app/raster equality remains a separate native replay gate.
remaining_gates: Full 638-scene + random actual CPU helper qualification in native-v7.
Same-ELF capability-off versus candidate full-frame command/raster/raw-context/lease/repair lifetime comparison.
